priceSnapshot.note: Price is 76,431.5, up 0.82 percent on the 24-hour open of 75,806.2. Against the midday publication at 75,440.2 that is 991.3 points and 1.31 percent HIGHER - the first session-over-session gain since 15 September midday, and it breaks the three-session losing chain the midday report flagged. Against the morning at 75,775.1 it is up 656.4, against midnight at 75,965.6 up 465.9. The shape of the move is the whole story: the 13:00 COT hour carried the FOMC statement, spiked to 76,558.7, then collapsed to 75,055.0 - a 1,503.7-point round trip inside sixty minutes on 1,513.7 BTC of volume, the heaviest hour of the day - and closed at 75,637.5. From that close price has climbed for six consecutive hours to 76,431.5 without giving back more than 400 points at any point. The 75,055.0 low is the second test of the 74,955.5 capitulation floor and it held with 99.5 points of clearance, the narrowest margin so far. FEED NOTE: the OKX proxy path was again heavily and unevenly cached this run, and the fix mattered. Through the sandbox web-fetch tool the /market/ticker payload was 12.9 hours stale (quoting 76,083.2 against a real 76,431.5), the 1H candle call at limit=300 was 13.6 hours stale, the 15m call at limit=97 was 18 DAYS stale, the long-short account ratio was 19.6 hours stale and the funding-rate record was the same 11:51 COT object the midday session had already discarded. All were thrown away. Everything quoted here was re-read through the BROWSER directly against okx.com, where the server clock matched to the second: ticker, open interest, funding and four paginated candle series. The one endpoint the browser could not reach is the rubik long-short-account-ratio route, which is CORS-blocked from a third-party origin - hence a null skew below rather than a stale number.

decisionBox.changed: Position stays ADD but the reasoning has flipped from 'buying a range that keeps grinding lower' to 'buying a floor that held a real test', and the tranche gets SMALLER rather than larger because the entry is 991.3 points worse. What changed is the event. The FOMC raised the funds rate 25 basis points to 3.75-4.00 percent on a unanimous 12-0 vote - the first hike since 2023 - and the projections show 16 of 18 participants expecting at least one more this year, with four seeing two. That is hawkish on both the action and the guidance, and yet: the 10-year FELL to 4.996 percent from the 5.04 it printed before the statement, Brent Nov'26 fell 0.87 percent to 104.91 after the midday read of 109.21, and BTC closed the six hours after the statement 794 points higher. The market read the hike as the END of the inflation-shock repricing rather than the start of one, and the collapse in crude is why - the Saudi pipeline premium that drove the whole September drawdown is coming out. Three technical facts support the tilt. Price reclaimed the 1H EMA50 at 76,350.4 for the first time since 12 September and the 1H MACD histogram is plus 97.01 and EXPANDING, against plus 26.71 and decaying at midday. The 4H EMA200 at 75,399.1 was pierced intraday by 344.1 points and the 4H bar closed back above it. And the realized-liquidation tape has fully inverted: 328,640 USD of longs were carried out between 17:02 and 17:53 COT, and since 18:10 COT there has been not one single long liquidation - 117,915 USD of SHORTS have been taken out instead, continuously, for the last eighty-four minutes. Against the tilt, and the reason this is a 6.0 and not a 7: the 13 September FLUSH RULE has now been TESTED at its seventh attempt and it FAILED the open-interest leg. BTC-USDT-SWAP open interest is 2,171,202,281 USD against the morning's verified 2,137,863,120 - up 1.56 percent in USD and roughly 0.7 percent in coin terms across a session where price rose. Leverage was REBUILT into this bounce, not washed out, exactly as it was on 15 September. 74,955.5 is still explicitly NOT confirmed as a flush low. Add to that a second consecutive day of spot-ETF redemptions - Farside has 16 September at minus 151.8 million with IBIT not yet reported, on top of 15 September's minus 450.4 - and an equity tape that gave the whole post-Fed pop back (QQQ closed plus 0.03 percent after trading 711.88), and this is a bounce with a thin foundation. Small tranche, no leverage, cash held back.

overnightRisk: The next report is at roughly 02:00 COT, six hours out, and the gap carries four specific risks rather than a general one. FIRST, the Fed's guidance has not been priced yet. The statement landed at 13:00 COT and Chair Warsh's press conference ran into the afternoon; the dot plot showing 16 of 18 participants expecting another hike this year is the kind of detail that gets re-read overnight by Asia rather than in the first hour. Equities already faded - QQQ traded 711.88 intraday and closed 704.72, VOO closed minus 0.43 percent - and BTC has NOT yet faded with them. That divergence usually closes toward equities, and it closes in the Asian session. SECOND, open interest is UP 1.56 percent on the session while price rallied, so the leverage carried into this gap is freshly added long leverage sitting above 76,000, the most fragile kind. The 76,400-76,460 band where 25,829 USD of shorts have been carried out in the last ninety minutes becomes the stop cluster if price turns. THIRD, the liquidation shelf beneath is now a genuine air pocket. 221,772 USD of longs were cleared at 75,625 and another 94,598 USD at 75,650-75,725 between 17:02 and 17:53 COT; that leverage is GONE, which means there is no longer a wall of forced buyers at 75,600 and a move through 75,637.5 has 582 points of nothing before 75,055.0 and another 99.5 before 74,955.5. FOURTH, the ETF tape reprints tomorrow morning with IBIT's 16 September line filled in. The partial is already minus 151.8 million without it; IBIT printed minus 161.7 on 15 September, and a repeat would take the two-day total past 750 million and put the largest fund on a visible redemption run into a hawkish Fed. The single number that decides the night is 75,637.5 on a settled hourly close. Above it, the post-Fed recovery is intact and 76,790.9 is the next thing to beat. Below it, the flush rule's warning about rebuilt leverage collects, and 74,955.5 gets its third test with far less forced buying underneath than it had this afternoon. A resting stop is NOT recommended tonight because price sits 794.0 points above the reduce level and 1,476.0 above invalidation - more than three times the 1H ATR of 497.6 - so a stop placed now is far likelier to be taken by noise than by the move it is meant to protect against. If the 02:00 session finds price under 76,000 with open interest still rising, that calculus reverses.

liquidityMagnet.note: Pull is UP on flow and DOWN on mass, and the split is the point. By MASS, 437,243 USD of the window sits below the mark against 9,312 USD above it - a 47-to-1 imbalance downward that looks devastating until you notice it is all HISTORY: every one of those fills is already executed. By FLOW, the tape has cleanly inverted. Between 17:02 and 17:53 COT it carried out 328,640 USD of longs and zero shorts. Since 18:10 COT it has carried out 117,915 USD of shorts and zero longs - eighty-four consecutive minutes with not one long liquidation, the longest such run in this file this month. At midday the same feed read 13.4-to-1 LONGS; it now reads 100 percent shorts. That is a genuine regime flip in the forced-flow direction and it is the single strongest item in the bull column tonight. The caveat is structural and unchanged: this is a realized tape over two and a half hours, not a forward heatmap, so it cannot show resting stop clusters ABOVE price. A keyed CoinGlass source would; this free feed cannot.

calibration.note: The midday 75,354.4 reduce gate did NOT fire, and this was the most expensive non-firing yet avoided. Price traded 75,055.0 in the 13:00 COT Fed hour - 299.4 points THROUGH the trigger, against the one point it managed at midday - and the hour closed 75,637.5, 283.1 points back above it. The settled-close requirement has now kept this wallet out of a wick five times in seven sessions, and today's was the largest: an exit on price would have sold the low of the day and would be 1,376.5 points offside six hours later. The 76,436.6 add gate did NOT fire either, but it came within five points: the 18:00 COT hour closed 76,201.2 and the 19:00 hour is trading 76,431.5, above the level on price but not yet on a settled close. The 74,955.5 INVALIDATION HELD with 99.5 points of clearance, the narrowest margin it has survived. No resting stop was recommended and none was needed; the 74,900.0 level was missed by 155.0 points, the closest call of the month. On money: midday BOUGHT a 10 USDT spot tranche at 75,440.2 and spot marks 76,431.5, so the tranche is 991.3 points and 1.31 percent onside, roughly plus 0.13 USDT on a 10 USDT slice. Hence TRUE - the first true on the discretionary line in four sessions, and it ends a run of three sub-0.05 USDT falses. What RESOLVED, and resolved against the bull case, is the 13 September flush rule at its seventh test. The liquidation leg passed emphatically: 328,640 USD of longs cleared between 17:02 and 17:53 COT and then a total inversion to shorts. The open-interest leg FAILED: OI is 2,171,202,281 USD against the morning's 2,137,863,120, up 1.56 percent while price rose, which is leverage rebuilding into a bounce - the identical pattern that invalidated the 15 September low. The account-ratio leg was again unverifiable, stale through the proxy and CORS-blocked in the browser. So the rule stands at seven tests with no clean pass, 74,955.5 is STILL not confirmed as a flush low even after being defended twice, and the midnight session inherits a floor that has held on price but not on positioning.
